render_invoice raises ValueError (message names the customer id and region) when the customer is known but get_tax_rate(region) is None, so no invoice with silently wrong tax is produced. Unknown customer (None) is shown with 0% tax as the rules say.
why: Spec is silent on known customers with a region missing from rates.csv. tax.compute_tax raises KeyError there (TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION). Raising a clear error is safer than printing a wrong tax amount.
